name: Minh Quang Ta
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Recent US assistant professor with substantive neural-perception-to-manipulation work and a current learning-enabled micro-robotics agenda. Broader control and optical-manipulation work is not automatically treated as AI.

physicalEvidence.summary: The CoRL2024 workshop study trains Mask R-CNN and PVNet on BlenderProc2 synthetic images, refines predicted poses, then uses them for actual UR5e/Robotiq Hand-E picking with a Basler camera. It assumes separated, unoccluded parts on a flat surface. Quantitative segmentation/pose benchmarks are synthetic; the physical section demonstrates picking, not a completed assembly line or a new learned motion policy. Ta is a UWF-affiliated coauthor, but acknowledgments and his CV link the work to the prior UIUC-FIT project. Current UWF access to that apparatus is unknown.

shortVisit.summary: Current first-person recruiting post seeks one or two funded PhD students for Spring2027. Applicants with a bachelor’s or master’s in CS and related fields are eligible for that degree route. No distinct current external-master visitor or internship invitation was verified. The October 2026 grant describes opportunities for UWF students, not external short visits.
